title: Madras High Court lauds law student's PIL which led to establishment of Bone Bank benefiting 197 patients
description: The Madras High Court recently observed that a public interest litigation (PIL) filed by a law student had helped secure the establishment of a bone bank at the Government Rajaji Hospital (GRH) in Madurai. [M. Vetri Selvan v. Union of India].In an order passed on July 13, the Court noted that 197 patients have benefited from the bone bank since 2022.
